# netbox_l2vpns (Data Source)

Lists l2vpn objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_l2vpns" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-l2vpn" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, identifier, identifier__empty, identifier__gt, identifier__gte, identifier__lt, identifier__lte, identifier__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, slug, slug__empty, slug__ic, slug__ie, slug__iew, slug__iregex, slug__isw, slug__n, slug__nic, slug__nie, slug__niew, slug__nisw, slug__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n, type, type__empty, type__ic, type__ie, type__iew, type__iregex, type__isw, type__n, type__nic, type__nie, type__niew, type__nisw, type__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `l2vpns` (Attributes List) The matching l2vpns. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--l2vpns))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--l2vpns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `l2vpns`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `export_target_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of exported route targets.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `identifier` (Number) Numeric identifier (e.g. the VNI or VPLS id), not the NetBox id.
- `import_target_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of imported route targets.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly unique shorthand; derived from name when not set.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: active, planned, decommissioning.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `type` (String) L2VPN technology. One of: vpws, vpls, vxlan, vxlan-evpn, mpls-evpn, pbb-evpn, epl, evpl, ep-lan, evp-lan, ep-tree, evp-tree, evpn-vpws, spb.
- `url` (String)
